description: Flat root: the inventory source's directory is also the playbook dir, so host_group_vars loads the same group_vars/ files twice, once at the inventory stage (L4/L6) and once at the play stage (L5/L7). With the default precedence the double load is invisible; a custom precedence that applies all_plugins_play after groups_plugins_inventory exposes it (group_vars/all.yml then beats group_vars/web.yml).
notes: host-custom-precedence: s = 'all' (the play-stage load of group_vars/all.yml is applied last); host-custom-precedence-no-pbdir: s = 'web' (no play stage from a neutral cwd). ansible-playbook site.yml agrees (research probe 12).
list-export-pbdir shows each group's vars once: --export merges the stages per group and cannot show the double load.
